# VNV Events

VNV Events is a South Florida event planning and event production company serving Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach.

## Main Services

- Wedding planning
- Corporate events
- Quinceaneras
- Baby showers
- Event rentals
- Flowers and decor
- DJ, sound and lighting
- Photo and video
- Catering coordination

- Miami-Dade

- Miami
- Doral
